title: CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth
abstract: arXiv:2610.01173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

translated_title: CAGE-NAS：面向高效模型增长的经认证函数下降方法
translated_abstract: 神经网络的渐进式增长需要决策：当前表示何时仍足以支持优化，何时应当进行扩展。CAGE-NAS 在函数空间中通过一个针对函数梯度近似的可采纳性准则来形式化这一决策。只要某个表示能够支持一步经过认证的函数梯度下降，架构就保持固定；当该准则失效时，则施加一种函数保持型扩展，并对所得到的新表示重新评估。作为主要实例，我们研究了由切空间所诱导的函数族，并使用函数梯度的正则化投影。在一个具有精确认证的受控环境中，CAGE-NAS 所生成的架构在相同参数预算下的所有可采纳备选方案中，其留出集 RMSE 性能位于第 99.8 百分位以上，而无需在增长轨迹中对这些方案进行逐一枚举。
tldr: CAGE-NAS 通过对函数梯度近似施加可采纳性认证来决定神经架构何时保持不变、何时进行函数保持型扩展，从而以高效方式实现模型的渐进式增长，并使生成架构的性能位居同参数预算下所有可采纳方案的前 0.2% 以内。
en_tdlr: CAGE-NAS uses a certified admissibility criterion on functional gradient approximations to decide when to keep an architecture fixed or apply a function-preserving expansion, enabling efficient progressive model growth with architectures ranking above the 99.8th performance percentile among admissible alternatives.
